metadata.name: Tutorial: Robot with Sensors
metadata.description: Train a robot to process sensor values and send results via bird

notes:
Tutorial: Robot with Sensors & Bird/Nest

SENSORS produce values when clicked:
- Die sensor: random (0-999999)
- Clock sensor: time in milliseconds

THE CHALLENGE:
Big numbers are hard to use!
We need MODULO to get small ones.

WATCH THE DEMO (click 'Show Me'):

1. START TRAINING:
   Click robot (yellow glow)

2. CLICK SENSOR:
   Click the die to get a random number

3. APPLY MODULO:
   Drag %10 onto the number
   Result: last digit (0-9)!

4. SEND VIA BIRD:
   Drag result onto the bird
   Bird delivers to the nest!

5. STOP TRAINING:
   Click robot to finish

TRY IT YOURSELF:
Click robot to run it again!
Each run produces a new random digit.

COLLECTING RESULTS:
Click the nest to take the top item.
(Oldest items come out first - FIFO)

MODULO MATH:
123456 % 10 = 6 (last digit)
123456 % 100 = 56 (last 2 digits)
